question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

BEST-SBET - TSEB

ROLE - LROE - ELOR
solution:
The logic followed here is:

BEST-SBET - TSEB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9a062ed5e70907b1f98e3f77138a00060d5153133d4c78d2130b6689d3c9463.png] 

And,

ROLE - LROE - ELOR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f37c4bfa7639ddc91df63f490fc2e01b11702f380ea8bd8ac287394f8f24309.png] 

Similarly,

DIVE - VDIE - EVID

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f556f06e630f5ab830b841ebeab1b1d25020f07240a7f63d41536213d425ea3d.png] 

Only option 2) follow same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
